title: Lakewatch is available in Beta
body: Lakewatch is now available in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Use Lakewatch to ingest security logs into governed tables, run detection rules, and investigate and respond to alerts on Databricks. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the [Previews](/aws/en/admin/workspace-settings/manage-previews#workspace) page. See [Lakewatch documentation](/aws/en/lakewatch).
